item.name: 429 - Rate Limit (run via Collection Runner, ~25 iterations)

exec: // Reset the observed flag on the first iteration of a Runner pass,
// so a leftover 'true' from a previous run can't hide a real failure now.
pm.test('status is 200 while still under the limit', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
// The actual fix for the silent-pass problem: previously, the ONLY
// pm.test() call was inside the 429 branch above, so if the burst never
// actually tripped the limiter across all iterations, ZERO assertions
// ever ran and Collection Runner reported a clean 'nothing failed' —
// which looks identical to a real pass. This final-iteration check makes
// 'the limiter was never actually observed to trigger' a real, visible
pm.test('rate limit was actually triggered at least once during this run (set Iterations high enough - >20 for STANDARD)', () => {

request.description: A single hit returns 200 with X-RateLimit-* headers. To actually trip the STANDARD-plan limit (default 20/min), select just this request in Collection Runner and set Iterations to 25 or more — you'll see 200s flip to 429s partway through. The final iteration's test FAILS if a 429 was never observed across the whole run, so an Iterations count set too low (or a misconfigured limit) shows up as a real failure, not a silent all-green pass. Run the same against apiKey2 afterward to confirm the other tenant is unaffected.
